name: M7.GlobalQuery.winners_exact
statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), (∀ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases ↔ M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x ∧ ∀ y : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases y → ¬ M7.Selection.better q.order (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases y) (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases x)) ∧ (M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases = ∅ ↔ ¬ ∃ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x)
guidance: Instantiate Selection.selector_exact over the whole Fin H × actual Record domain. Competitors range over every class and action, never only the current base orbit. Simplify univ membership and feasibleSet emptiness. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.
